purpose: Resolve reconstruction inputs by source authority without collapsing evidence classes.

precedence.rule: Direct current measurement or mechanically/metric registered geometry governs current as-built dimensions when provenance and residuals are valid.
Direct current photos/video/visible part observation governs visible topology and state; perspective images alone do not create metric truth.

Direct technical statements from people materially involved with this wheel have priority over external analogies and unsupported reconstruction assumptions for function, terminology, assembly logic and intended construction.
Local historical drawings govern documented historical design, but are not silently promoted to current as-built geometry.
Unregistered local scan supports form/visibility comparison but not mechanical location or metric truth.
Comparable water-wheel construction expands candidate space only and cannot override local evidence.
Brute-force or engineering candidates remain hypotheses until promoted by stronger evidence.

ThorstenHalsch.caveat: Expert authority outranks analogy and unsupported model assumptions, but does not replace direct current measurement for metric geometry.

promotion_rule: Synthetic geometry may enter the Truth Model only when supported by current observation/measurement or by explicit expert construction knowledge for the claimed non-metric property. Metric values still require metric evidence.
